subject: Observability pricing: retention, tracing, dashboards — follow-up from demo
raw_messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@strataops.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@strataops.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Observability follow-up after today's demo

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the dashboards looked good and the tracing previews were helpful. Before we bring this to procurement and security, we need a clearer picture on pricing for the observability add-ons: specifically retention pricing for traces (per GB/day or month), whether tracing data can be EU-resident only, and how advanced dashboards are packaged.

A couple quick asks:
- Can you share a compact pricing grid for retention tiers (30/90/365 days) and per-GB costs?
- Is there an SLA for trace ingestion and retrieval under Dedicated vs Hosted?
- Any one-time setup or migration credits you typically offer for pilots?

We'd like to get a formal quote to share with procurement this week.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Senior Platform Engineer, StrataOps
elena.rossi@strataops.com

Elena —

Great to hear — glad the demo was helpful. I'm looping Ben (AE) who owns pricing for the account. Quick answers while Ben prepares the grid:
- Yes, EU-only data residency is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted we have EU-region variants and contractual clauses (we'll include the language).
- We typically prepare a 30/90/365 retention grid with per-GB/month pricing and a separate SLA line for trace query latency.
- For pilots we commonly offer a one-time credit and a migration assistance package (depends on committed starting ARR / pilot duration).

Ben — can you put together the pricing grid and a short options matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) by EOD tomorrow?

I'll also attach the sample retention-SLA diff doc.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@strataops.com>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:30:00 +00:00
Subject: Observability pricing options + pilot credit proposal

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is a concise pricing grid and an initial proposal. Highlights:
- Retention tiers (traces): 30d = $0.45/GB/month, 90d = $0.33/GB/month, 365d = $0.20/GB/month (EU-region pricing is ~8% premium due to regional infra costs).
- Advanced dashboards (per-seat + feature tier): Standard Dashboards included; Advanced Dashboards add-on $3,500/month (up to 10 editors) or $0.40/editor/month for larger seat counts.
- Tracing SLA: Hosted (best-effort 95th p99 ingestion <200ms), Dedicated (SLA-backed 99.9% ingestion within 150ms, trace retrieval SLOs documented).
- One-time pilot credit: $15k applied to first 3 months for initial onboarding (subject to 6-month pilot minimum consumption).

Attachments: Observability-Pricing-Grid.xlsx, StrataOps_MAProposal_v2.pdf

Open to adjusting the credit / retention bands depending on committed starting ARR. If you'd like, we can move to a short call Thursday to walk through the grid.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

---
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@strataops.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 14:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Observability pricing options + pilot credit proposal

Ben / Mina —

Thanks for the details and the attachments. A few items procurement/security wants clarified before we can accept:
1) The EU-premium: can you provide a cost-breakdown showing the 8% delta (network egress, storage, compliance ops)? Procurement will need a line-item.
2) The tracing SLA sounds good for Dedicated — does that SLA include KV-cache / hot-cache eviction behavior during heavy load? We need guarantees for sub-200ms tail retrieval for service-level dashboards.
3) The pilot credit is appreciated but procurement is asking if this can be moved to a usage rebate (i.e., credit spread over 6 months tied to metered consumption) rather than a single upfront credit.

Also — are there any constraints on exporting trace data if we need to ship to our on-prem analytics?

Could you put a short reply addressing those three points and update the proposal? We will also loop in our security lead if needed.

Regards,
Elena

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@strataops.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Observability pricing options + pilot credit proposal

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the thorough questions. Responses below and I've made a proposed amendment to the attached proposal (StrataOps_MAProposal_v2.pdf) with two alternative commercial structures.

1) EU premium break-down:
   - Storage costs (replicated EU mirrors + redundancy): ~4.2%
   - Network egress & cross-AZ replication: ~2.6%
   - Compliance & region-specific support (legal reviews, data processing terms): ~1.2%
   Total: ~8.0% (we can provide a more formal cost worksheet under NDA).

2) Tracing SLA details and cache behavior:
   - The Dedicated SLA covers ingestion and retrieval SLOs. During very high load, hot-KV-cache eviction is governed by a defined policy; eviction events are monitored and we provide a mitigation path (read-through to cold store with guaranteed degraded SLO).
   - For guaranteed sub-200ms tail retrieval we recommend: Dedicated with 2x hot-cache sizing and a cross-zone hot-cache replication option (one-time config + ~15% uplift on Dedicated capacity). We'll add the technical appendix to the proposal.

3) Pilot credit as rebate: acceptable. We can restructure the $15k pilot credit as a usage rebate applied monthly over 6 months (pro-rated to consumption), conditional on a minimum 6-month pilot and signing an addendum.

Attachments updated: StrataOps_MAProposal_v2.pdf (amended commercial options), Observability-Pricing-Grid.xlsx (annotated).

Next steps: If this aligns, we can issue a formal quote and draft the pilot addendum for legal review. Happy to join a 30-min call with your procurement/security if that helps.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
